name: A10
notes: NVIDIA's own-branded A10 -- distinct from AWS's A10G (see gpus/a10g.json), confirmed via an official AWS-published NVIDIA A10G datasheet showing meaningfully different specs (A10G: 300W TDP, FP32 35 TFLOPS, 80 RT cores vs A10's 150W, 31.2 TFLOPS, 72 RT cores). Do not treat these as the same part under two names. Note A10G's Tensor Core throughput (TF32/BF16/FP16/INT8) is actually LOWER than A10's despite A10G's higher TDP and RT core count -- see gpus/a10g.json notes for the full comparison and a flagged anomaly (A10G's TF32 dense equals its FP32, not 2x FP32 as on every other Ampere part in this dataset including A10). cuda_cores/tensor_cores/sm_count not stated numerically in official NVIDIA A10 docs (only 'third-generation Tensor Cores' and '72 (2nd-generation) RT Cores' given by name/count respectively). No NVLink (PCIe-only card, confirmed absent from both A10 datasheet and product brief). multi_instance_max null: A10 Product Brief explicitly states 'Multi-Instance GPU (MIG): Not supported'. process_node_nm of 8 (Samsung 8nm '8N' custom process) is NOT found in any official NVIDIA A10 document -- it is corroborated only by three independent third-party aggregator sources (no disagreement among them), and is recorded here as best-available with that caveat; treat with lower confidence than fields sourced directly from NVIDIA. Note Samsung's '8N' is itself a custom/enhanced 10nm-class process marketed as '8nm', not a strict linear feature size -- 8 is an approximation of a marketing name. release_date of 2021-04-12 is NVIDIA's GTC21 announcement date, confirmed via NVIDIA press release/blog, distinct from AWS's separate, later A10G announcement (2021-11-11/12, see gpus/a10g.json) -- these are two different announcement events for two different products, not the same date. No FP64 or FP8 Tensor Core figures given (FP8 postdates Ampere; FP64 not listed on this datasheet).

_sources.process_node_nm: Not NVIDIA-primary-sourced -- corroborated by 3 independent third-party sites: videocardz.net/nvidia-a10 ('Fabrication Process: 8 nm (SAMSUNG 8N)'), sysrqmts.com GPU comparison ('Foundry: Samsung / Manufacturing process: 8 nm'), geeks3d.com GTC 2021 roundup ('process: Samsung 8nm' for the related GA102 A5000/A6000 SKUs)
_sources.slot_width: https://www.nvidia.com/content/dam/en-zz/Solutions/Data-Center/a10/pdf/A10-Product-Brief.pdf (Table 1: 'Mechanical Form Factor: Full-height, full-length (FHFL) 10.5", single slot')
